title: Bahria College Karsaz, Karachi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Bahria College Karsaz, located in Karachi, Pakistan. Address: V3MX+V6Q, PNS Karsaz Rd, Karsaz, Faisal Cantonment, Karachi.
